hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && f=$(realpath "$f") && d=$(dirname "$f"); while [ "$d" != / ] && [ ! -f "$d/pyproject.toml" ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; [ -f "$d/pyproject.toml" ] || exit 0; cd "$d" && uv run --quiet ruff format --quiet "$f" && uv run --quiet ruff check --fix --quiet "$f" >&2 || exit 2
